title: This Drive-Thru Has TWO Windows 🍔
description:
At this drive-thru, there's one window. Some evenings a second one is lit, past the end of the wall, and everybody in town drives right by it.

My big brother has ordered for me every Friday for eleven years. Tonight I wanted to order my own. He wanted the better fries.

It's made up. A creepy blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Comment PICKLES if someone always orders for you.
